target.title: Stream native reasoning events through agent subscriptions
target.body:
## Summary

- emit native reasoning streams to agent subscribers even when the channel has no `onReasoningStream` callback
- keep native `thinking_delta` delivery on the Gateway/WebChat event path instead of requiring channel-specific reasoning callbacks
- avoid streaming native reasoning placeholder text and handle cumulative `text_delta` payloads that omit `delta`
- normalize OpenAI-compatible reasoning delta fields (`reasoning_content`, `reasoning`, `reasoning_text`) and classify Volcengine Ark endpoints as native OpenAI-compatible reasoning providers

## Scope

This PR includes both pieces needed for the validated ArkClaw reasoning-stream path:

1. Core event path: native `thinking_delta` can reach Gateway/WebChat subscribers as `agent.stream = "thinking"` without a channel-specific `onReasoningStream` callback.
2. Provider normalization: OpenAI-compatible reasoning deltas are normalized into native thinking blocks, and Volcengine Ark endpoints are declared through the Volcengine provider manifest as `volcengine-native`.

It does not add a broad provider/model support matrix. Other providers still need their own adapter coverage when their raw stream fields or enablement parameters differ.

Internal ArkClaw validation used `2026.5.28-arkclaw-reasoning.3`; this PR carries the generic Core + Provider behavior from that patch while leaving out ArkClaw-specific debug switches, debug log prefixes, and internal naming.

Refs #5086 and extends the direction in #87481 by making callback-less native reasoning delivery available to Gateway/WebChat subscribers and by including the provider normalization required by the validated Volcengine Ark path.

## Validation

- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/openai-completions-compat.test.ts src/agents/provider-attribution.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.before-terminal-delivery.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.subscribe-embedded-agent-session.subscribeembeddedagentsession.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-utils.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Notes for maintainers

Volcengine Ark endpoint URLs are declared in `extensions/volcengine/openclaw.plugin.json` via the existing provider manifest metadata path. Core only recognizes the generic `volcengine-native` endpoint class and capability gates; it does not hardcode Ark base URLs or ArkClaw-specific debug behavior.
